candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record documents a ruptured popliteal artery aneurysm evidenced by the large expanding hematoma (23 × 3 cm posterior thigh collection), acute hemoglobin drop from 119 to 77 g/L, and emergent presentation with worsening pain. C001 names only the underlying structural lesion (saccular popliteal artery aneurysm) without capturing the rupture, which is the critical and required component of the benchmark reference.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Identifies the aneurysm but omits the rupture component, which is the defining event in the reference diagnosis

case_quality_flags: Reference diagnosis requires both the aneurysm type and its rupture state; candidates omitting rupture are inherently partial.
